captions.formal: Continuous traffic flows as motion-blurred streaks along a wide urban road lined with yellow-leaved trees, flanked by mid-rise and high-rise buildings under clear golden-hour light. On-screen text identifies “KOREA ILLIES ENGINEERING” and “TAS PARK INSURANCE” on visible structures.
captions.sarcastic: Golden-hour sunlight dramatically illuminates this utterly ordinary urban highway, where motion-blurred cars race past “KOREA ILLIES ENGINEERING” like they’re late for a very important meeting with insurance.
captions.humorous_tech: Traffic streaks like unoptimized render threads down a leaf-golden urban highway, while “KOREA ILLIES ENGINEERING” and “TAS PARK INSURANCE” sit in prod—no rollbacks, no alerts, just golden-hour uptime.
captions.humorous_non_tech: Yellow-leafed trees watch as cars blur past like late commuters fleeing a meeting with “KOREA ILLIES ENGINEERING” — even insurance signs look judgmental in golden-hour light.

captions.formal: A fluffy ginger kitten advances slowly toward the camera across sun-dappled dirt beneath dense green foliage, maintaining direct eye contact with tail slightly raised. The stationary low-angle shot emphasizes its deliberate paw lifts against the leafy backdrop.
captions.sarcastic: This ginger furball’s daring mission: traverse six inches of dirt while maintaining eye contact, clearly unaware that “stealth” isn’t part of the feline playbook. The forest? Utterly conquered.
captions.humorous_tech: This ginger kitten deploys a low-latency approach toward camera, tail up like a success flag, debugging the sun-dappled dirt path one deliberate paw at a time under leafy prod conditions.
captions.humorous_non_tech: This ginger fluffball marches toward you like a tiny general inspecting troops, tail high and paws dramatic, because apparently the dirt patch under those trees is now his kingdom.

captions.formal: A woman with dark skin and a high bun types continuously at a white desk in an office, her pink-painted fingernails visible as she focuses on the desktop screen. The setting includes other desks, black chairs, potted plants, and circular ceiling lights.
captions.sarcastic: She’s absolutely crushing it at the keyboard—fingernails pink, gaze locked, typing like the fate of office productivity hinges on her next keystroke. Truly, a hero in a light shirt over orange.
captions.humorous_tech: Her pink nails deploy rapid keystrokes like a critical hotfix, eyes glued to the screen as she debugs the workday in a sterile office prod environment—no merge conflicts, just pure focus.
captions.humorous_non_tech: She’s got that focused stare and pink nails flying over the keys like a keyboard ninja who just discovered her boss’s coffee stash is running low. Office plants watch in awe—this is peak desk drama.

captions.formal: Water cascades over dark moss-covered rocks within dense green foliage, generating white spray and mist. The static medium shot captures continuous flow under natural diffused lighting, with no visible human or artificial elements.
captions.sarcastic: Water, in its infinite wisdom, chooses to fall over mossy rocks for the entire duration—clearly a thrilling performance art piece titled “Gravity: The Untold Story.”
captions.humorous_tech: Water deploys continuously over mossy rocks in a forest prod environment, generating misty error logs with zero downtime—no standups, no merge conflicts, just pure, uninterrupted flow.
captions.humorous_non_tech: Water, ever the overachiever, pours itself relentlessly over mossy rocks like it’s got a deadline only it can see—surrounded by lush greenery that just watches, unimpressed.

captions.formal: Crowds of pedestrians cross a wide urban intersection in organized waves, while vehicles navigate between phases. Modern glass buildings and sidewalk trees frame the scene; a black sedan is mid-intersection as a green-and-yellow taxi waits nearby.
captions.sarcastic: A black sedan bravely dares to occupy the intersection while pedestrians politely stroll along the curb—clearly unaware they’re interrupting its profound journey across two lanes.
captions.humorous_tech: Pedestrians deploy in synchronized waves across the crosswalks, while vehicles debug their routes through the intersection—prod incident avoided, but that black sedan’s timing still needs a code review.
captions.humorous_non_tech: Crowds surge across the striped crosswalks like synchronized commuters in a dance-off, while cars sneak through gaps—because apparently, even taxis need to wait their turn behind a white truck with a mysterious covered bed.

captions.formal: A player in neon yellow cleats dribbles along a white line on artificial turf at dusk as a challenger in blue cleats approaches. Two sprinters, one in blue and one in maroon, chase the ball toward a distant goal under twilight skies.
captions.sarcastic: Neon-yellow cleats glide dramatically along a white line—because nothing says “high-stakes training” like dribbling toward a teammate who’s just now deciding to care. Twilight, turf, and questionable life choices complete the scene.
captions.humorous_tech: Player in neon yellow cleats deploys a dribble along the white line—blue-cleated challenger triggers a merge conflict. Two sprinters race downfield like a hotfix chasing prod; turf, twilight, no rollbacks allowed.
captions.humorous_non_tech: Neon-yellow cleats slide along the white line like a showoff who forgot everyone’s watching—then blue cleats crash the party, and two sprinters bolt after the ball like it owes them lunch money.

captions.formal: A black frying pan containing chopped red onions, mushrooms, red peppers, zucchini, and eggplant is repeatedly tossed over an open flame on a metal grill grate. Flames rise around the pan as vegetables arc through the air against a dark background.
captions.sarcastic: A black pan full of veggies—eggplant included, obviously—gets dramatically tossed over open flames like it’s auditioning for a culinary action movie. The vegetables? They’re just along for the ride, glistening and confused.
captions.humorous_tech: The black pan deploys veggies—eggplant included—into prod via airborne tosses over open-flame grill, while smoke logs errors and flames handle the hotfixes. No unit tests, just sizzle.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A black pan full of veggies—eggplant included—gets tossed like a nervous chef’s last hope over open flames, while the zucchini just tries to keep its dignity mid-air.

captions.formal: Dark tree branches with bright green leaves frame falling water droplets illuminated by strong backlighting, set against a hazy outdoor landscape with out-of-focus palm trees. Lens flare intensifies, producing glowing orbs and streaks as a faint rainbow arc appears near the bottom left.
captions.sarcastic: The water droplets, clearly exhausted from falling so hard, put on a dazzling light show—lens flare’s grand finale, complete with a rainbow cameo, because nature loves a dramatic exit.
captions.humorous_tech: Water droplets deploy as micro-LEDs through backlighting, while lens flare escalates like an unhandled prod incident—glowing orbs takeover, and a rainbow debug artifact pops up left.
captions.humorous_non_tech: Dark branches and leafy greens host a raindrop ballet under spotlight glare—until the sun throws a tantrum, flooding the scene with glowing orbs and a rainbow’s shy wave goodbye.

captions.formal: A person wearing dark-rimmed glasses remains motionless as scrolling blue and green code projects across their face in a dim environment. The right lens reflects a grid interface; the left shows partial text including “for count = 0” and “function get”.
captions.sarcastic: A person in dark-rimmed glasses stares fixedly as code scrolls over their face—clearly the pinnacle of multitasking: reading syntax while simultaneously becoming the screen.
captions.humorous_tech: Deploying live to prod with zero testing: a coder in dark-rimmed glasses stares blankly as debug logs scroll over their face—left lens shows “for count = 0”, right lens? A grid. No rollback button.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A person in dark-rimmed glasses stares straight ahead as glowing lines crawl over their face like overeager subtitles at a silent movie—left lens whispers “for count = 0,” right lens just shows bars. Clearly, someone’s lost the remote.
